Team — thanks to Nimbus and everyone who joined this morning. Quick recap of what we ran and immediate action items:  

What we did:
- 09:30–10:00: Prompt review and tokenization checks (validated prompt_set.csv; adjusted a few templated instructions to reduce 2–3 tokens per call).
- 10:00–10:20: Routing policy walkthrough and canary plan (region fallback + low-cost variant as fallback).
- 10:20–10:30: Controlled load window — ramped up to 50 rps, observed p95 latency ~ 280ms, no errors; collected KV cache hit-rate.

- Dev (dev_patel): update runbook_v1.pdf with the observed thresholds and include traffic shaping example (due 2026-12-22).
- Marissa (marissa_cole): prepare a short config diff for the routing policy to support canary rollouts and provide the template for Sentinel alerts (due 2026-12-23).
- Nimbus (Sara / Kyle): rotate the ephemeral SSO and confirm production data access constraints (due 2026-12-21).
- Tessa (tessa_morgan): schedule follow-up hands-on deep dive (prompt tuning + extended load) — proposed 2026-12-28 09:30–11:00 PST; will send calendar invite pending confirmations.

Artifacts shared: runbook_v1.pdf; load_test_config.yaml; prompt_set.csv (from Nimbus). HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-98721
